Load the libraries 

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(gplots)     # heatmap.2
    library(dendextend) # make and color dendrogram
    library(colorspace) # diverge_hcl / rainbow_hcl / heat_hcl color palettes
    library(readr)      # read_csv
})
```

Load the data
```{r}
# Load the data
protein_data <- read_csv("./data/input/protein_data_normnoNCB.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Set 'protein' column as row names
protein_data <- as.data.frame(protein_data, check.names = FALSE)
rownames(protein_data) <- protein_data$protein

# Remove 'protein' column
protein_data <- protein_data[,-1]

# Round values to 2 decimal places
protein_data <- round(protein_data, 2)

# Check the data
head(protein_data)
```


Initialize an empty data frame for storing GO protein data
```{r}
GOprotein_data <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = ncol(protein_data), nrow = 0), check.names = FALSE)
condition_list <- as.character(colnames(protein_data))
colnames(GOprotein_data) <- condition_list

```

```{r}
# Initialize an empty vector to store all unique proteins found in .tsv files
master_protein_list <- character()

# Get the list of .tsv files from the directory
file_list <- list.files(path = "./data/input/ranked", pattern = "\\.tsv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Collect all proteins from the .tsv files
for (file in file_list) {
  
  # Read the tsv file
  tsv_data <- read_tsv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Split the protein names in 'matching proteins in your input (labels)' column
  protein_list <- unlist(strsplit(tsv_data$`matching proteins in your input (labels)`, ","))
  protein_list <- as.character(protein_list)
  
  # Add proteins to the master list (ensure no duplicates by using unique)
  master_protein_list <- unique(c(master_protein_list, protein_list))
}

# Subset protein_data by keeping only the rows where the protein names are in master_protein_list
GOprotein_data <- protein_data[rownames(protein_data) %in% master_protein_list, ]

# Check the resulting subset
print(dim(GOprotein_data))  # Print the dimensions of the subset
head(GOprotein_data)        # Preview the first few rows

```

Remove columns with all NA values

```{r}
#remove columns with all NA values
GOprotein_data <- GOprotein_data[, colSums(is.na(GOprotein_data)) < nrow(GOprotein_data)]
head(GOprotein_data)
```

Based on the GOprotein_data, create a heatmap and PCA plot
```{r}
heatmap_data <- as.data.frame(GOprotein_data, check.names = FALSE)
heatmap_data[is.na(heatmap_data)] <- 0
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[order(rowMeans(heatmap_data, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE),]
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[,order(colMeans(heatmap_data, na.rm = TRUE), decreasing = TRUE)]
```

Heatmap
```{r}
library(pheatmap)
heatmap_data2 <- heatmap_data
heatmap_data2 <- heatmap_data2[, !colnames(heatmap_data2) %in% '3DhEV']
pheatmap(heatmap_data2, scale = "column", cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE, show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = TRUE, color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100))

dev.print(pdf, "heatmap_redo.pdf", width = 8.46, height = 10.34)
```



PCA plot libraries
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggfortify)
```

```{r}
# Ensure GOprotein_data is numeric
PCA_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(GOprotein_data, as.numeric, check.names = FALSE))
PCA_data <- PCA_data[, apply(PCA_data, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) != 0]

# Perform PCA without additional scaling
pca_data <- prcomp(t(PCA_data), scale. = FALSE)

# Extract conditions from column names
conditions <- colnames(GOprotein_data)

# Create a data frame for plotting
pca_df <- data.frame(pca_data$x)

# Extract color_group and shape_group
pca_df$color_group <- gsub("^[0-9]+D|FPLC|(_S\\d+)", "", conditions)  # Remove prefix and suffix for color
pca_df$color_group <- as.factor(pca_df$color_group)  # Convert to factor for shape
pca_df$shape_group <- gsub(".*?([0-9]+D|FPLC).*", "\\1", conditions)  # Remove suffix for shape
# Rename the shape levels
pca_df$shape_group <- gsub("2D", "UC 2D", pca_df$shape_group)
pca_df$shape_group <- gsub("3D", "UC 3D", pca_df$shape_group)
pca_df$shape_group <- gsub("FPLC", "FPLC 3D", pca_df$shape_group)
pca_df$shape_group <- ifelse(pca_df$color_group %in% c("EV", "hEV", "NV"), "DGUC 3D", pca_df$shape_group)
pca_df$shape_group <- as.factor(pca_df$shape_group)  # Convert to factor for color

pca_df$combined_group <- interaction(pca_df$color_group, pca_df$shape_group)

# Use the combined_group for color and shape in the plot
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = color_group, shape = shape_group), size = 8) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_data$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca_data$sdev^2) * 100, 2), "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_data$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pca_data$sdev^2) * 100, 2), "%)"),
         title = "") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("UC 2D" = 17, "DGUC 3D" = 18, "UC 3D" = 15, "FPLC 3D" = 8)) +  # Custom shapes
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Particle",order = 1), shape = guide_legend(title = "Method"))

dev.print(pdf, "PCA_redo2.pdf", width = 8.46, height = 8.46)
```

```{r}
# Ensure GOprotein_data is numeric
PCA_data <- as.data.frame(lapply(GOprotein_data, as.numeric, check.names = FALSE))
PCA_data <- PCA_data[, apply(PCA_data, 2, var, na.rm = TRUE) != 0]

# Perform PCA without additional scaling
pca_data <- prcomp(t(PCA_data), scale. = FALSE)

# Extract conditions from column names
conditions <- colnames(GOprotein_data)

# Create a data frame for plotting
pca_df <- data.frame(pca_data$x)

# Extract color_group and shape_group
pca_df$color_group <- gsub("^[0-9]+D|FPLC|(_S\\d+)", "", conditions)  # Remove prefix and suffix for color
pca_df$color_group <- as.factor(pca_df$color_group)  # Convert to factor for color
pca_df$shape_group <- gsub(".*?([0-9]+D|FPLC).*", "\\1", conditions)  # Extract part for shape
# Rename the shape levels
pca_df$shape_group <- gsub("2D", "UC 2D", pca_df$shape_group)
pca_df$shape_group <- gsub("3D", "UC 3D", pca_df$shape_group)
pca_df$shape_group <- gsub("FPLC", "FPLC 3D", pca_df$shape_group)
pca_df$shape_group <- ifelse(pca_df$color_group %in% c("EV", "hEV", "NV"), "DGUC 3D", pca_df$shape_group)
pca_df$shape_group <- as.factor(pca_df$shape_group)  # Convert to factor for shape

# Define custom color and shape mappings
color_mapping <- c("EVP" = "#E69F00", "EV" = "lightpink", "EVP" = "purple", "Exomere" = "blue", "Supermere" = "darkgreen", "hEV" = "salmon", "Other" = "#56B4E9")  # Example color mapping
shape_mapping <- c("UC 2D" = 16, "UC 3D" = 17, "FPLC 3D" = 18)  # Example shape mapping

# Plot with a unified legend
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = color_group, shape = shape_group), size = 8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_mapping) +  # Apply the custom color mapping
  scale_shape_manual(values = shape_mapping) +  # Apply the custom shape mapping
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pca_data$sdev[1]^2 / sum(pca_data$sdev^2) * 100, 2), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pca_data$sdev[2]^2 / sum(pca_data$sdev^2) * 100, 2), "%)"),
       title = "") +
  guides(color = guide_legend("Group", 
                              override.aes = list(shape = shape_mapping)))  # Override shapes within color legend

```
